patterns: Bash stays the noisiest tool all month, erroring 9-12% of main calls versus under 2% for read.
Advisor-doctrine runs landed in the week's top 5 costliest sessions four weeks out of five.
Edit errors jumped from under 1% to 6-8% in the last two weeks of September.
Eval error rate climbed all month, from 8.8% to 15.7%.
Tofu's share of weekly prompts fell every week, from 84% to 22%.
Weekly cost swung wildly instead of trending: down 54%, up 39%, down 48%, down 36%.
